paragraphs.text: Pavel Maliki is a legendary wanderer whose origins and lifetime on Dominaria are unknown.

Pavel Maliki is known for his wandering nature and his efforts to assist those in dire circumstances. Some see his actions as a sign of deep generosity, while others speculate that his deeds might stem from a desire to atone for past transgressions
In the Latin text accompanying his image, "Pavel Malachorum Dux [...] Deus Providebit" translates to "Pavel of Malachi, leader [...] God will provide."
